# scoop-boot package list (delivered by scoop-boot.ps1 --update; do not edit).
# One manifest per line in install order; "#" starts a comment; "bucket/name" is
# passed to Scoop as written. To change the list on one machine, copy this file to
# etc\packages\<hostname>.txt (lower case host name): it replaces this file completely
# and is never touched by --update. Bootstrap packages (7zip, git, aria2, sudo,
# innounp, dark, lessmsi, wget, cacert) are installed before this list and are not
# listed here. Packages with a post-install step in scoop-complete-install.ps1:
# vcredist2022 temurin25-jdk msys2 nmap 7zip notepadplusplus vscode python314
# jetbrains-toolbox greenshot (see -ListPackages).
